IT-4308                                                                                                                  about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 14-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Agile Software Development for Engineers [IT-4308]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Explore the challenges and benefits of applying Kanban to knowledge work, such as IT  
  support, marketing, or research and development. Discuss how visualizing work,  
  limiting work in progress, and continuous improvement can enhance knowledge work            (5)  
  A)      processes in Kanban.  
  
  B)      Illustrate how organizations combine Kanban and Agile practices to achieve a flexible  
  and adaptive approach to project and product development.                                   (5)  
  
  2)           How does Continuous Integration (CI) ensure code quality and collaboration among  
  team members?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate with an example, the challenges that occur when creating DevOps pipelines?       (5)  
  3)           Illustrate the steps used to transfer from traditional approach to agile process by  
  considering Retail and E-commerce Industry.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Give the need of Product Backlog. Illustrate the artifacts involved in the scrum process  
  with an example.                                                                            (5)  
  
  4)           Evaluate how Jira and Azure DevOps facilitate Agile project management in enterprise  
  environments. What are the strengths and limitations of each tool in managing cross-  
  functional collaboration, scaling frameworks like SAFe, and supporting remote or            (5)  
  A)      hybrid teams?  
  
  B)      How would you approach stakeholder engagement and requirement gathering in a  
  dynamic Agile environment with diverse user personas? Outline a strategy to ensure          (5)  
  continuous feedback and adaptation throughout the development cycle.  
  
  5)           Analyze how integrating DevOps practices impacted your Agile delivery pipeline. What  
  metrics improved or declined?  
  (5)  
  A)
